name: freeipa-server-gpo-frontend
description: Sources of the GPUI editor. The build writes plugin directory (UMD/AMD bundle js/app.js, js/app.css, chain.js, gpo.js, img/) into dist/, which is committed and installed by the RPM.

scripts.test: node scripts/build-test-root.mjs && vitest run --project unit --project integration --project stories
scripts.test:ipa: bash scripts/ipa-up.sh && REQUIRE_IPA=1 vitest run --project e2e && bash scripts/ipa-native.sh
scripts.format: prettier --write src dev scripts tests .storybook '*.mjs' tsconfig.json tsconfig.strict.json package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src dev scripts tests .storybook '*.mjs' tsconfig.json tsconfig.strict.json package.json .prettierrc.json
